description.value: Echo Landing is the newest ski-in, ski-out property at Sun Peaks Resort, a major four-season mountain destination in the Thompson-Okanagan region. The contemporary townhomes and condos range from 2 to 4 bedrooms, each with a full kitchen, and sit in the quieter east village near the Orient chairlift and BC's highest-elevation golf course. Sun Peaks also operates a full bike park with rentals, lessons, and a pedal-access trail network directly accessible from the resort village.
